title: File Organizer
requirements: Move files into subfolders by extension (`Images/`, `Docs/`, `Code/`…) using a `std::map<std::string, std::string>` rule table
`--dry-run` mode that only prints what it would do
Report: counts and total sizes per category (`std::format` with KB/MB/GB)
Find duplicate files (same size, then same content hash)
